shellCommands.command: node server.js & sleep 1; curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/books -d 'title=Dune&author=Frank+Herbert&notes=desert' -o /dev/null -w 'add:%{http_code} '; curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -o 'Dune\|mark finished' | sort -u; ID=$(curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -oP '/books/\K[\w-]+' | head -1); curl -s localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -o 'Dune\|Frank Herbert\|desert'; curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish -o /dev/null -w 'finish:%{http_code} '; curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -c 'finished 20'; cat books.json | head -12; kill %1
